assumptions.message: Added a unique trackingCode string to Delivery so customers can track their parcel progress without an account.
Added fee field to Delivery so driver earnings can be calculated for today and this week upon successful delivery.
Assigned small, medium, large as standard values for parcelSize enum.
Added customer role to auth roles and created a dedicated tracking area alongside drivers and dispatch areas based on the drivers domain specification.
Configured bright orange #f97316 accent with playful, glass, and minimal look recipes as suggested by mobile courier on-demand design patterns.

Design direction: Food Delivery / On-Demand (Hero-Centric Design + Feature-Rich); palette Appetizing warm (orange/red) + trust blue + map accent; fonts Startup Bold (Outfit + Rubik) (Outfit / Rubik); from ui-ux-pro-max@28b3b8dee8c9

unresolved.message: How delivery fees are determined (e.g. flat rate, calculated by parcel size, or distance) is unspecified in the requirements.
Whether shop owners or dispatchers can cancel deliveries after they have been accepted by a driver is not specified.
